name: miki-template
description: Django-Style template engine for Node.js and Express
author: Alain Miki aka Coder Miki

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function walk(d){const out=[];for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())out.push(...walk(p));else if(/\\.test\\.(cjs|mjs|js)$/.test(e.name))out.push(p);}return out;}const files=walk('tests');require('child_process').execSync('node --test '+files.join(' '),{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push origin main
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push origin main
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push origin main
